# Output Directory Documentation

This directory contains figures generated from the opihi morphology and microhabitat analysis scripts.

## Figure Catalog

```{r figure-catalog, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
png_files <- list.files(
  path = ".",
  pattern = "\\.png$",
  full.names = FALSE
)

for (i in seq_along(png_files)) {

  pretty_name <- png_files[i] |>
    tools::file_path_sans_ext() |>
    gsub("[-_]", " ", x = _) |>
    tools::toTitleCase()

  writeLines(c(
    paste0("### Figure ", i, ". ", pretty_name),
    "",
    paste0(
      '<img src="', png_files[i],
      '" alt="', pretty_name,
      '" width="650">'
    ),
    ""
  ))
}
